verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב בַּשִּׁטִּ֑ים הָעָ֔ם וַיָּ֣חֶל לִזְנ֖וֹת אֶל־ בְּנ֥וֹת מוֹאָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·šeḇ baš·šiṭ·ṭîm hā·‘ām way·yā·ḥel liz·nō·wṯ ’el- bə·nō·wṯ mō·w·’āḇ
verses.literal: While Israel was staying in Shittim the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab

verses.original: וַתִּקְרֶ֣אןָ לָעָ֔ם לְזִבְחֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ן הָעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אכַל וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֖וּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·re·nā lā·‘ām lə·ziḇ·ḥê ’ĕ·lō·hê·hen hā·‘ām way·yō·ḵal way·yiš·ta·ḥăw·wū lê·lō·hê·hen
verses.literal: who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods And the people ate and bowed down to these gods

verses.original: יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבַ֣עַל וַיִּצָּ֥מֶד פְּע֑וֹר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה וַיִּֽחַר־ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·rā·’êl lə·ḇa·‘al way·yiṣ·ṣā·meḏ pə·‘ō·wr ’ap̄ Yah·weh way·yi·ḥar- bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor and the anger of the LORD burned against [them]

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַ֚ח אֶת־ כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָעָ֔ם וְהוֹקַ֥ע אוֹתָ֛ם נֶ֣גֶד הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ לַיהוָ֖ה יְהוָ֖ה חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ וְיָשֹׁ֛ב מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’el- mō·šeh qaḥ ’eṯ- kāl- rā·šê hā·‘ām wə·hō·w·qa‘ ’ō·w·ṯām ne·ḡeḏ haš·šā·meš Yah·weh Yah·weh ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- wə·yā·šōḇ mî·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses Take - all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD so that [His] fierce anger may turn away from Israel

verses.original: מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שֹׁפְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִרְגוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו הַנִּצְמָדִ֖ים לְבַ֥עַל פְּעֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh ’el- way·yō·mer šō·p̄ə·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl hir·ḡū ’îš ’ă·nā·šāw han·niṣ·mā·ḏîm lə·ḇa·‘al pə·‘ō·wr
verses.literal: So Moses . . . told the judges of Israel Each of you must kill all of his men . . . who have joined in worshiping vvv Baal of Peor

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֡ה מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אִישׁ֩ בָּ֗א וַיַּקְרֵ֤ב אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית לְעֵינֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וּלְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהֵ֣מָּה בֹכִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh mib·bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš bā way·yaq·rêḇ ’el- ’e·ḥāw ’eṯ- ham·miḏ·yā·nîṯ lə·‘ê·nê mō·šeh ū·lə·‘ê·nê kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl wə·hêm·māh ḇō·ḵîm pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Just then an Israelite . . . man vvv brought to his family - a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses [and] the whole congregation . . . of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting

verses.original: וַיַּ֗רְא פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיָּ֙קָם֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח רֹ֖מַח בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar pî·nə·ḥās ben- ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên way·yā·qām mit·tō·wḵ hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yiq·qaḥ rō·maḥ bə·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: On seeing this Phinehas son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest got up from the assembly took a spear in his hand

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹא אַחַ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אִֽישׁ־ אֶל־ הַקֻּבָּ֗ה וַיִּדְקֹר֙ אֶת־ שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ אֶל־ קֳבָתָ֑הּ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַתֵּֽעָצַר֙
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’a·ḥar yiś·rā·’êl ’îš- ’el- haq·qub·bāh way·yiḏ·qōr ’eṯ- šə·nê·hem ’êṯ ’îš yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- ’el- qo·ḇā·ṯāh hā·’iš·šāh ham·mag·gê·p̄āh mê·‘al bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl wat·tê·‘ā·ṣar
verses.literal: followed . . . the Israelite . . . into the tent and drove [the spear] through - both of them - vvv through the Israelite - and on through the belly of the woman So the plague against the Israelites . . . was halted

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֕וּ הַמֵּתִ֖ים בַּמַּגֵּפָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃פ
verses.literal: - but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000 . . . . . .
Then the LORD said to Moses . . .

verses.original: פִּֽינְחָ֨ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־ חֲמָתִי֙ מֵעַ֣ל בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּקַנְא֥וֹ קִנְאָתִ֖י בְּתוֹכָ֑ם אֶת־ וְלֹא־ כִלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּקִנְאָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: pî·nə·ḥās ben- ’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên hê·šîḇ ’eṯ- ḥă·mā·ṯî mê·‘al bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·qan·’ōw qin·’ā·ṯî bə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’eṯ- wə·lō- ḵil·lî·ṯî ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bə·qin·’ā·ṯî
verses.literal: Phinehas son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest has turned - My wrath away from the Israelites . . . for he was zealous [for My sake] among them - so that I did not consume - the Israelites . . . in My zeal

verses.original: אֱמֹ֑ר לָכֵ֖ן הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֥ן ל֛וֹ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י שָׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ĕ·mōr lā·ḵên hin·nî nō·ṯên lōw ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: Declare therefore that I am granting him - My covenant of peace

verses.original: וְהָ֤יְתָה בְּרִ֖ית עוֹלָ֑ם כְּהֻנַּ֣ת לּוֹ֙ אַחֲרָ֔יו וּלְזַרְע֣וֹ תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִנֵּא֙ לֵֽאלֹהָ֔יו וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām kə·hun·naṯ lōw ’a·ḥă·rāw ū·lə·zar·‘ōw ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer qin·nê lê·lō·hāw way·ḵap·pêr ‘al- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him vvv and his descendants because - he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites . . .

verses.original: וְשֵׁם֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַמֻּכֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֻכָּה֙ אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית זִמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ סָל֑וּא נְשִׂ֥יא לַשִּׁמְעֹנִֽי׃ אָ֖ב בֵֽית־
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm ’îš yiś·rā·’êl ham·muk·keh ’ă·šer huk·kāh ’eṯ- ham·miḏ·yā·nîṯ zim·rî ben- sā·lū nə·śî laš·šim·‘ō·nî ’āḇ ḇêṯ-
verses.literal: The name vvv of the Israelite who was slain - - with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu the leader of a Simeonite family . . .

verses.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הַמֻּכָּ֛ה הַמִּדְיָנִ֖ית הָֽאִשָּׁ֧ה כָּזְבִּ֣י בַת־ צ֑וּר אֻמּ֥וֹת רֹ֣אשׁ בְּמִדְיָ֖ן הֽוּא׃פ אָ֛ב בֵּֽית־
verses.transliteration: wə·šêm ham·muk·kāh ham·miḏ·yā·nîṯ hā·’iš·šāh kā·zə·bî ḇaṯ- ṣūr ’um·mō·wṯ rōš bə·miḏ·yān hū ’āḇ bêṯ-
verses.literal: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi the daughter of Zur a tribal chief of a Midianite . . . family . . .
And the LORD . . . said to Moses . . .
Attack - the Midianites and strike them dead -

verses.original: כִּ֣י הֵם֙ צֹרְרִ֥ים לָכֶ֔ם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִכְּל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּע֑וֹר וְעַל־ דְּבַ֞ר אֲחֹתָ֔ם כָּזְבִּ֨י בַת־ מִדְיָן֙ נְשִׂ֤יא הַמֻּכָּ֥ה בְיוֹם־ הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּעֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: kî hêm ṣō·rə·rîm lā·ḵem bə·niḵ·lê·hem ’ă·šer- nik·kə·lū lā·ḵem ‘al- də·ḇar- pə·‘ō·wr wə·‘al- də·ḇar ’ă·ḥō·ṯām kā·zə·bî ḇaṯ- miḏ·yān nə·śî ham·muk·kāh ḇə·yō·wm- ham·mag·gê·p̄āh ‘al- də·ḇar- pə·‘ō·wr
verses.literal: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and - their sister Cozbi the daughter of the Midianite leader [the woman] who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor
